notes.title: Update 1.0.02
notes.notes:
Minor patch update

- Fixed the Big Rat boss attack bug.
- Difficulty balance changes:
	• Increased the time between attacks of enemies that shoot projectiles.
	• Reduced the speed of some enemies.
	• Reduced the health of some enemies.
	• Increased the spawn interval in the Wild and Brutal levels.
	• Standardized boss damage: Now all bosses deal 2.0 damage, regardless of difficulty.

Note: Modifiers are still available, allowing players to add more challenges if desired.
